notes.title: December News
notes.content:
[h2][b]Alpha and Level Zero[/b][/h2]
After putting together concept art and level design in the previous month, the alpha level has been created and playtested! Mostly featuring on mechanics and gameplay, below are some screens of the level in-game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/9e03d9ae696544e799f0eae97d899376b8a15c11.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/798fae6cebd86e9b2dc3890fd7225840ff1d0bfc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Cleanup[/h2]
This level focuses on an abandoned sawmill, clean up tracks and debris left behind. You can now visually see some of the effects from the pollution in the water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/9b29e10636ddfe0f93cd15204f972b4a2c21f7e2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/54fb0a7900153ecca95099544560c4422f3791ad.jpg[/img]

[h2]Overlays[/h2]
Look into elements such as toxins, oxygen levels, and more with selectable overlay maps. This can help you visually track your progress and see what areas need more care.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/113fe82c9cabf2e26078b3fa636c9b68ab89fa3d.png[/img]

Make sure to wishlist our game, and you can also subscribe to our newsletter to get updates directly to your inbox [url=https://eatcreatesleep.us11.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=1a5eccc1a56aab7580ddd0e5a&id=fa6da55a32]here[/url]! Or [url=https://eatcreatesleep.net/social/]follow us[/url] on our other social media platforms. 

Until next time, have a safe holiday season!

notes.title: Kickstarter - Early 2021
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

It's been awhile, I hope you're safe. We're still working and things are finally settling after the "Covid crater" as a colleague put it. It's been a hectic few months since March, 2020. But now we're back to inform that we will launch a new Kickstarter campaign in early 2021! Let's start with showing our work in progress intro to celebrate (soon you can see it in glorious three dimensions).


[previewyoutube=MDR2REC4k-4;full][/previewyoutube]



[h1]What's Been Happening?[/h1]
In short we've spent these months trying to survive, doing work for hire, applying for loans, grants and investments. We also spent two months pitching to a major publisher and almost got signed with a huge budget, but fell through. It's also been interesting to transition to a complete remote team, from being in an office for 5+ years. We're going to work remotely as long as the pandemic continues.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/ddc1d781cc5994355e15d3a043280588c387394d.jpg[/img]


We've found more work for hire until the end of the year and our investors have given us some more money to keep going. We're in a position where half of the team can work full on with the prototype and prepare for the new release.



[h1]Improved Prototype[/h1]
Since March, 2020 we've improved the feedback and are upgrading the visuals, the economy system and improved the animal AI and mechanics. It's still a proof of concept, but we're trying to show how we can iterate with feedback. There's still no insects though, sorry. ;) Check out the paintover below with our new "Eco Ship", a VTOL aircraft (vertical take-off and landing), it will complement our awesome eco van.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/6b87344d40b8208d6f7a84b7ea2c4b8e11daadd3.jpg[/img]


[h1]A New Kickstarter[/h1]
We're doing a new campaign in the beginning of next year, early 2021. There are publishers who are slightly interested, but a lot of people in the game industry are on the fence, they want us to show numbers, some feel that games about the environment and ecology is too niche. If you ask me I think it's something that anyone on Earth can relate to in some way, but I digress. We're going to show everyone that Among Ripples: Shallow Waters is a game people want, and with you, our early fans we're going to make it!


[h1]Let's Stay in Touch[/h1]
We've updated our social media presence, and right now we communicate through Twitter, Instagram and our newsletter mainly. If you want to stay up to date or check out cute pictures of our pets, that's where to be.

//Martin & Eat Create Sleep[/h3]

notes.title: New Demo Available
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have now uploaded the new demo for you to try out. In the new sandbox maps you can explore more of the possibilities of the game. Each map has its own season. 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/dc6f545268b9ae7ae1512a4237e109f960d369af.png[/img]





[h2]Download the Demo Here[/h2]* [url=https://eatcreatesleep.itch.io/ar-shallow-waters]itch[/url]
* [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/AR-shallowwaters/456389]Gamejolt[/url]
* [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/among-ripples-shallow-waters]IndieDB[/url]
* [url=eatcreatesleep.net/demo/]Our server if you sign up to the newsletter[/url]



[h2]Unlock the Full Demo[/h2]We have added three new sandbox maps with different seasons and a new toxic trash gameplay mechanic. To play these you need to subscribe to our newsletter. Everyone who are already subscribed can download the new demo and login with your email to unlock the new demo. What the game does is simply ask Mailchimp (our newsletter provider) if you're subscribed and if Mailchimp says yes you're good to go. :)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/febd1de271d712124ba8fd55fe9242c3741163a1.png[/img]


[h2]Coming to Steam Soon[/h2]We were not able to upload the demo in time, Valve will review it for release here on Steam for a few days. We will update you when it's finally online here. But if you're really itching to try it you still have four other ways!



---

Happy Holidays from the Eat Create Sleep team!
